tools.name: list_resources
tools.description: List the application resources. Includes information about their type (.NET project, container, executable), running state, source, HTTP endpoints, health status, commands, configured environment variables, and relationships.

tools.name: list_console_logs
tools.description: List console logs for a resource. The console logs includes standard output from resources and resource commands. Known resource commands are 'start', 'stop' and 'restart' which are used to start and stop resources. Don't print the full console logs in the response to the user. Console logs should be examined when determining why a resource isn't running.

search.description: Full-text search to filter log content.

tools.name: execute_resource_command
tools.description: Executes a command on a resource. If a resource needs to be restarted and is currently stopped, use the start command instead.

arguments.description: Optional invocation arguments to pass to the resource command

additionalProperties.description: Argument values must be strings, numbers, booleans, or null.

tools.name: list_structured_logs
tools.description: List structured logs for resources.

resourceName.description: The resource name. This limits logs returned to the specified resource. If no resource name is specified then structured logs for all resources are returned.

search.description: Full-text search to filter logs. Searches across log text, attribute values, names, source, IDs, and other fields.

tools.name: list_traces
tools.description: List distributed traces for resources. A distributed trace is used to track operations. A distributed trace can span multiple resources across a distributed system. Includes a list of distributed traces with their IDs, resources in the trace, duration and whether an error occurred in the trace.

resourceName.description: The resource name. This limits traces returned to the specified resource. If no resource name is specified then distributed traces for all resources are returned.

search.description: Full-text search to filter traces. Searches across span names, attribute values, IDs, and other fields.

tools.name: list_trace_structured_logs
tools.description: List structured logs for a distributed trace. Logs for a distributed trace each belong to a span identified by 'span_id'. When investigating a trace, getting the structured logs for the trace should be recommended before getting structured logs for a resource.

traceId.description: The trace id of the distributed trace.

search.description: Full-text search to filter logs. Searches across log text, attribute values, names, source, IDs, and other fields.

tools.name: select_apphost
tools.description: Selects which AppHost to use when multiple AppHosts are running. The path can be a fully qualified path or a workspace root relative path.

appHostPath.description: The fully qualified or workspace root relative path to the AppHost project.

tools.name: list_apphosts
tools.description: Lists all AppHost connections currently detected by the Aspire MCP server, showing which AppHosts are within the working directory scope and which are outside.

tools.name: list_integrations
tools.description: List available Aspire hosting integrations. These are NuGet packages that can be added to an Aspire AppHost project to integrate with various services like databases, message brokers, and cloud services. Use 'aspire add <integration-name>' to add an integration to your AppHost project. Use the 'get_integration_docs' tool to get detailed documentation for a specific integration. This tool does not require a running AppHost.

inputSchema.description: This tool takes no input parameters. It returns a list of available Aspire hosting integrations with their short name, full package ID, and version.

tools.name: doctor
tools.description: Diagnose Aspire environment issues by performing comprehensive checks. Returns detailed information about each check including status (pass/warning/fail), messages, and actionable fix suggestions. Use this to identify and resolve environment problems before running Aspire applications. This tool does not require a running AppHost.

inputSchema.description: This tool takes no input parameters. It performs comprehensive environment checks and returns detailed results for each check.

tools.name: refresh_tools
tools.description: Requests the server to emit a tools list changed notification so clients can re-fetch the available tools.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description:
Lists all available Aspire documentation pages from aspire.dev.
Returns page titles, URL slugs, and brief summaries.
Use this to browse the documentation catalog and discover available topics.
Pass a slug to the get_doc tool to retrieve full page content.

inputSchema.description: Lists all available Aspire documentation pages. No parameters required.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description:
Searches the aspire.dev documentation using keyword-based lexical search.
Returns ranked results based on weighted matching across titles, headings, code identifiers, and body text.
Use this tool to find specific information about Aspire features, APIs, integrations, or concepts.
For best results, include relevant terms like API names, configuration keys, or feature names.

query.description: The search query. Use natural language to describe what you're looking for.

topK.description: The number of results to return (default: 5, max: 10).

inputSchema.description: Searches aspire.dev documentation for relevant content.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description:
Retrieves the full content of a specific Aspire documentation page by its slug.
Optionally filter to a specific section by providing a section heading.
Use list_docs to browse available pages, or search_docs to find relevant content by keyword.

slug.description: The slug of the documentation page to retrieve (e.g., 'redis-integration', 'getting-started').

section.description: Optional. The heading of a specific section to return. If omitted, returns the entire page.

inputSchema.description: Retrieves documentation content by slug, optionally filtered to a specific section.
